--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
theorem mod_modEq (a n) : a % n ≡ a [MOD n] :=
  mod_mod _ _

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fin
/-- The equivalence induced by `a ↦ (a / n, a % n)` for nonzero `n`.
This is like `finProdFinEquiv.symm` but with `m` infinite.
See `Nat.div_mod_unique` for a similar propositional statement. -/
@[simps]
def Nat.divModEquiv (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : ℕ ≃ ℕ × Fin n where
  toFun a := (a / n, ↑a)
  invFun p := p.1 * n + ↑p.2
  -- TODO: is there a canonical order of `*` and `+` here?
  left_inv _ := Nat.div_add_mod' _ _
  right_inv p := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Fin.ext <| Nat.mul_add_mod_of_lt p.2.is_lt)
    dsimp only
    rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ n.pos_of_neZero, Nat.div_eq_of_lt p.2.is_lt,
      Nat.zero_add]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bitwise
lemma bit_mod_two_eq_one_iff (a x) :
    bit a x % 2 = 1 ↔ a := by
  simp

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.ZModChar
/-- The value of `χ₄ n`, for `n : ℕ`, depends only on `n % 4`. -/
theorem χ₄_nat_mod_four (n : ℕ) : χ₄ n = χ₄ (n % 4 : ℕ) := by
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_mod n 4]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Part
theorem some_mod_some [Mod α] (a b : α) : some a % some b = some (a % b) := by simp [mod_def]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNat_aux_eq (q k : ℕ) : sModNat_aux (4 % q) q k = sModNat q k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [sModNat_aux, ih, sModNat, ← ih]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
theorem add_mod_add_of_le_add_mod {a b c : ℕ} (hc : c ≤ a % c + b % c) :
    (a + b) % c + c = a % c + b % c := by rw [← add_mod_add_ite, if_pos hc]

--src: Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
theorem val_add {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a b : ZMod n) : (a + b).val = (a.val + b.val) % n := by
  cases n
  · cases NeZero.ne 0 rfl
  · apply Fin.val_add

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic
theorem Prime.eq_two_or_odd {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : p = 2 ∨ p % 2 = 1 :=
  p.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one.imp_left fun h =>
    ((hp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd 2 (dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h)).resolve_left (by decide)).symm

theorem equiv_S5_KT4B : (Hilbert.S5 ℕ) =ₛ (Hilbert.KT4B ℕ) := by
  /-
    ⊢ LO.System.Equiv (LO.Modal.Hilbert.S5 Nat) (LO.Modal.Hilbert.KT4B Nat)
  -/
  apply Kripke.equiv_of_eq_FrameClass ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass ReflexiveTransitiveSymmetricFrameClass;
  /-
    ⊢ Eq LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveTra …
  -/
  apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset;
    /-
      case a
      ⊢ HasSubset.Subset LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass LO.Modal.Kripk …
    -/
  . rintro F ⟨F_refl, F_eucl⟩;
    /-
      case a.intro
      F : LO.Modal.Kripke.Frame
      F_refl : Reflexive F.Rel
      F_eucl : Euclidean F.Rel
      ⊢ Membership.mem LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveTransitiveSymmetricFrameClass F
    -/
    refine ⟨F_refl, trans_of_refl_eucl F_refl F_eucl, symm_of_refl_eucl F_refl F_eucl⟩;
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
    /-
      case a
      ⊢ HasSubset.Subset LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveTransitiveSymmetricFrameClass LO.M …
    -/
  . rintro F ⟨F_refl, F_eucl, F_symm⟩;
    /-
      case a.intro.intro
      F : LO.Modal.Kripke.Frame
      F_refl : Reflexive F.Rel
      F_eucl : Transitive F.Rel
      F_symm : Symmetric F.Rel
      ⊢ Membership.mem LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass F
    -/
    refine ⟨F_refl, eucl_of_symm_trans F_symm F_eucl⟩;
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
